title: Potato Biology — Canonical Layer Index
purpose: Provide one route through potato biology from evolutionary ancestry and DNA to molecular regulation, cells/tissues, organism development, ecology, disease and storage.
epistemic_rule: Literal plant science is owned here. Symbolic or philosophical crosswalks may reference these records but do not modify biological facts.

layer_stack.question: Where did the lineage, cultivar and haplotype come from?
How is genomic capacity regulated and signalled?
How do organelles, cells, tissues and resource flows produce the physical organism?
Which developmental state and source/sink role is active now?
How do pathogens, stress, wounds and storage alter the system?
Which high-confidence biological principles are safe to reuse elsewhere?

cross_scale_chain: lineage → genome/pangenome → haplotype/dosage → chromatin/epigenome → RNA → protein/signalling → metabolite/flux → organelle → cell → tissue → organ → whole-plant state → microbiome/pathogen/environment → reproduction/next generation
unresolved_biology_frontiers: single-cell/spatial transcriptomic atlas across stolon-to-tuber transition
cultivar-specific 12×4 chromosome browsers with validated coordinate tracks
fully phased epigenome and allele-specific expression maps across developmental stages
mechanistic integration of mechanoperception with tuberization
causal microbiome experiments that distinguish association from function
quantitative water/nutrient/carbon flux models coupled to genotype
complete potato pangenome including broader global/wild diversity
cell-scale mechanics of tuber swelling and periderm growth
route_rule: When a page says 'potato biology', start here rather than pulling unsorted facts from scattered project files.
